_README: Read data/requirements/README.md before editing. Every entry below is text_status='paraphrase_for_demo': a plain-English restatement written for this project, based on the published structure of the named instrument. No entry reproduces the text of a standard. Nothing here may be used to assert an actual regulatory position.

requirements.obligation_text: A hot work permit is valid for a single shift and shall not exceed 8 hours.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the permit-validity obligation in the published structure of OISD-STD-105 (work permit system). Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Gas testing shall be carried out immediately before hot work commences.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the pre-commencement gas test obligation in OISD-STD-105. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Gas testing shall be repeated at intervals not exceeding 2 hours while hot work continues.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the periodic gas test obligation in OISD-STD-105. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Gas testing shall be repeated before work resumes if work has been suspended for more than 30 minutes.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the post-suspension re-test obligation in OISD-STD-105. This is the sub-obligation most often omitted from site procedures, which is why it is atomised separately. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Equipment shall be positively isolated and the isolation recorded on the permit before work begins.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the positive isolation obligation in OISD-STD-105. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Pressure vessels shall undergo external visual inspection at intervals not exceeding 12 months.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the external inspection periodicity in the published structure of OISD-STD-128 (inspection of pressure vessels). Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Pressure vessels shall undergo internal inspection or an equivalent thickness survey at intervals not exceeding 48 months.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the internal inspection periodicity in OISD-STD-128. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Wall thickness readings shall be recorded against fixed condition monitoring locations so that a corrosion rate can be trended.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the CML recording obligation in OISD-STD-128. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Critical rotating equipment shall be covered by a condition monitoring programme with a defined measurement interval.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the condition monitoring obligation in the published structure of OISD-STD-130 (inspection of rotating equipment). Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Pumps in hydrocarbon service shall have their mechanical seal support system checked at each preventive maintenance intervention.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the seal support system obligation in OISD-STD-130. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Startup procedures for centrifugal pumps shall require confirmation that suction conditions meet the equipment's minimum requirement before the machine is started.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the startup precondition obligation in OISD-STD-130. Not verbatim standard text. This requirement is the one the demo corpus is built to fail: SOP-4412 revision 3 does not contain a suction pressure confirmation step, and two seal failures resulted.

requirements.obligation_text: Inspection intervals shall be set from an assessment combining probability of failure and consequence of failure.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the risk-based inspection principle in the published structure of OISD-STD-145. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Every dangerous part of machinery shall be securely fenced or otherwise guarded while in motion.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the machinery fencing duty in Section 21 of the Factories Act 1948. The Act is public domain, but this wording was written for this project and has NOT been checked against the gazette text. Replace with verbatim text and a citation before relying on it.

requirements.obligation_text: Every pressure plant shall be examined by a competent person at the prescribed interval and a record of the examination maintained.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the pressure plant examination duty in Section 31 of the Factories Act 1948. Not checked against the gazette text.

requirements.obligation_text: An occupier of a factory involving a hazardous process shall maintain an up-to-date on-site emergency plan.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the on-site emergency plan duty introduced by Chapter IV-A of the Factories Act 1948. Not checked against the gazette text.

requirements.obligation_text: A pressure vessel used for storage of compressed gas shall be hydrostatically tested at the prescribed periodicity and the test certificate retained.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the periodic hydrotest obligation in the published structure of the PESO SMPV (Unfired) Rules. Not verbatim rule text.

requirements.obligation_text: Measuring equipment used to verify conformity shall be calibrated or verified at defined intervals against traceable standards, and records retained.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the monitoring and measuring resources requirement in ISO 9001:2015 clause 7.1.5. ISO text is paywalled; this is a restatement of the clause's published scope, not the clause.

requirements.obligation_text: The effectiveness of corrective action taken in response to a non-conformity shall be reviewed and recorded.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the corrective action effectiveness requirement in ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Hazards shall be eliminated or risks reduced using the hierarchy of controls, with engineering controls preferred over administrative controls.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the hierarchy of controls requirement in ISO 45001:2018 clause 8.1.2. Not verbatim standard text.

requirements.obligation_text: Documents describing an asset shall be revised when an approved change alters that asset.
requirements.provenance_note: Paraphrase of the management-of-change documentation duty common to OISD and ISO 45001 practice. Not verbatim standard text. This requirement is testable purely from graph state: an MOC that CHANGED an asset, and a Document that DESCRIBES that asset whose revision predates the change, is a silent-drift gap.
